questions.question:
1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6 are written on different faces of a dice. Three different positions of the same dice are shown below. Find the number on the face opposite to the one showing '4'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97064475b6374b7328a9f71cd5a11ca21590625169549f91329f5424bc3c39b8.png]
questions.solution:
For find the opposite surface of '4', we need to compare the common surface in the given dices,

So, From Dice 1 and Dice 2,

When we move in clockwise direction starting from 6 we get;

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c048ca63f5eead59931ca6a43814d85563356951185e5b0f8dbb2475ed4b5cbe.png] 

In dice 1, 6 is adjacent to 5 and 2.

In dice 2, 6 is adjacent to 4 and 1.

→ 6 ⇔ 6; 2 ⇔ 1; **5 ⇔ 4**

So, the remaining '**5**' will be the opposite face of '4'.

Hence, the correct answer is "5".

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some Fishes are Cats.

All Cats are Soft.

**Conclusions:**

I. All Soft are Cats.

II. Some Fishes are Soft.

options.text: Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
Statements:

Some Fishes are Cats.

All Cats are Soft.

The least possible Venn diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ade10528416562f7ea1e43a65430f434eb943e059dd6086182dfc3b661d8e614.png] 

Conclusions:

I. All Soft are Cats. - **False **(because All cats are soft so All soft are cats it is possible only)

II. Some Fishes are Soft. - **True **(because Some Fishes are Cats and All Cats are Soft. So, Some Fishes are Soft too)

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion II follows."**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘+’, ‘B’ denotes ‘×’, ‘C’ denotes ‘−’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘÷’, then what will come in place of ‘?’ in the following equation?

(98 C 8) B 2 A 16 = ?
questions.solution:
Given Equation: (98 C 8) B 2 A 16 = ?

BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a45b5b9191c13cd4da310eb8df100becb078c240f4b0e763420ec154fb42a5fd.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 Alphabet
 A
 B
 C
 D
 
 
 
 

 Meaning
 +
 ×
 −
 ÷
 
 

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ (98 C 8) B 2 A 16 = ?

⇒ __**(98 − 8)**__ × 2 + 16 = ?

⇒__** 90 × 2**__ + 16 = ?

⇒ __**180 + 16**__

⇒ **196**

Hence, the correct option is "Option 3".

questions.question: Seven girls - H, J, K, L, M, N and O - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. Only four girls sit between O and N. Only O sits to the right of L. H sits exactly between J and K. Who among the following sits at the extreme left end of the row?

Given: Seven girls - H, J, K, L, M, N and O - are sitting in a straight row, facing north.
